info.name: CYCLES_MATERIAL_SUBSURFACE
comment: Cycles vendor extension: random-walk subsurface scattering on the
'physicallyBased' material (the KHR PBR material has no SSS).
'subsurface' blends between the diffuse lobe and a subsurface lobe whose
albedo is 'baseColor' (Cycles' Principled BSDF has no separate subsurface
color socket). 'subsurfaceRadius' is the per-channel mean free path in
refraction and phase function. Note that 'metallic' (default 1.0 per the
ANARI registry) suppresses the diffuse/subsurface lobe entirely, so SSS
materials should set metallic to 0. All defaults equal the Cycles

parameters.name: subsurface
parameters.description: subsurface scattering weight (blend between diffuse and subsurface lobes)

parameters.name: subsurfaceRadius
parameters.description: per-channel subsurface mean free path (object-space units)

parameters.name: subsurfaceIor
parameters.description: index of refraction used by the random-walk subsurface scattering

parameters.name: subsurfaceAnisotropy
parameters.description: Henyey-Greenstein phase anisotropy of the subsurface scattering [-1, 1]
